title: Christmas Lights Tour - The 11th Edition
seo_title: Christmas Lights Bike Tour, 11th Edition in Springfield, MO
description: This is a free group bike ride around Springfield to look at Christmas decorations, covering a 10-12 mile route with Christmas music playing from a big speaker. Riders can decorate themselves and their bikes; the ride is in the dark and likely cold, so dress warmly, and headlights and taillights are required. It starts Saturday, December 19, 2026 at 6:00 PM and runs until about 7:30 PM at Jarrett Middle School, 906 W Portland St, Springfield, MO.
